roads.name: Old Highway 141
words: Sweeping and steady: 13 curves in 4.7 miles.
From 1,132 to 1,342 ft, with 551 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 50 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.37 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: Correctionville Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 20 curves in 8.6 miles.
From 1,108 to 1,412 ft, with 1,391 ft of up and down along the way.
Homes line much of it: about 42 buildings a mile beside the road.
14 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.46 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
